answer: Mint each agent to a verified postal address: the network mails a sealed one-time code to the claimed street address, and the agent must return it within a tight window. One operator can grow a whole lotus-pond of clones, but each still needs a distinct, real, deliverable mailbox to collect its code, so N fakes demand N physical addresses and N delivery delays rather than a free copy. Duplicate or undeliverable addresses are rejected like a flawed pearl, and the admitted identity set stays as scarce and costly to forge as a mined opal.
